titulo: From the neighbourhood to the city
intro: How a city is organised, the places that serve its people, and everyday words for travel, the post and public spaces.

bloques.texto:
**Territory.** A big city is divided into **distritos** and **barrios**. **La ciudad**, **el pueblo**, **el centro**, **las afueras**.

**Places.** **La biblioteca** lends books; **el museo** shows art; **el mercado** sells fresh food; **la plaza** is where people meet; **el parque** is for walking. **La estación** is where trains arrive, with **un encargado** who runs it and **empleados** at each **oficina**.

**If you lose your suitcase** on a trip, you go to **la oficina** of lost property.

**Travel.** **Un viajero** carries **una maleta**; **un conductor** drives the bus; **el turismo** is travel for pleasure. **Un tren**, **un autobús**, **un billete**.

**The post.** **Un cartero** brings letters. **Una carta**, **un paquete**, **un sello**.

**Description.** **Histórico**, **céntrico**, **provisional**: **un museo histórico**, **un piso céntrico**, **un documento provisional**.

**Manners.** **La cortesía**, **la amabilidad**; **ser amable**, **ser buena persona**. **El progreso**: a city that improves its parks and libraries.

frases.es: El último día de mi viaje a Sevilla perdí la maleta, o quizá me la llevó otro viajero por error.
frases.en: On the last day of my trip to Seville I lost my suitcase, or perhaps another traveller took it by mistake.
analisis: El último día de mi viaje a Sevilla

frases.es: En la estación, un empleado me explicó con mucha amabilidad que tenía que ir a la oficina.
frases.en: At the station, an employee explained to me very kindly that I had to go to the office.

frases.es: La oficina central estaba en el centro, a tres kilómetros, pero había otra en mi mismo barrio.
frases.en: The main office was in the centre, three kilometres away, but there was another in my own neighbourhood.

frases.es: Delante de la puerta había un cartel, y dentro, una cola de personas con el mismo problema.
frases.en: In front of the door there was a sign, and inside, a queue of people with the same problem.

frases.es: El empleado rellenó un documento provisional para que pudiera recuperar la maleta.
frases.en: The employee filled in a temporary form so that I could get the suitcase back.

frases.es: Me dijo que debía comprobar qué horario tenía la oficina, y me deseó buen viaje.
frases.en: He told me I should check what hours the office had, and wished me a good journey.

bloques.pregunta: According to the text, who filled in the temporary document?

opciones.The employee: El empleado rellenó un documento provisional.
opciones.The traveller: The traveller was the one who needed the document.
opciones.The postman: No postman appears in the story.

opciones.texto: They dealt with me very kindly.
opciones.explicacion: Me atendieron means they served or dealt with me, and amabilidad means kindness.

opciones.texto: They attended me with many friends.
They waited for me with much love.
opciones.explicacion: Atender: to deal with. Amabilidad: kindness.

bloques.frase: Tuve que ir a la oficina para recuperar la maleta
bloques.traduccion: I had to go to the office to get my suitcase back.

**The app cannot check this part.** For the writing, please use pen and paper. For the speaking, say it out loud and, if you can, practise with a native speaker or a teacher who can correct you.

**Write (100–120 words).** Explain how your city is divided, from the neighbourhood to the centre.

**Speak (about 2 minutes).** Tell aloud what you would do if you lost your suitcase on a trip.
